gaming.description: Aggressive, competitive, calls out plays in real time.

chill.name: Chill Companion
chill.description: Calm, witty, great for late-night streams and long Q&As.

variety.description: Energetic, jokes with everyone, keeps chat constantly engaged.

irl.description: Adventurous, shares reactions to life events and surroundings.
